name: MCP egress guard
summary: Block toolkit MCP tool calls whose arguments name a host outside the server's declared egress.
description: A deterministic fail-closed pre-tool gate that extracts every URL and host from a Youdede MCP tool call, normalizes it with the WHATWG URL parser, and blocks hosts absent from the egress list generated from the curated server profiles.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks toolkit MCP tool calls whose arguments name a host outside the declared egress; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not accept a lookalike, subdomain, userinfo, IP, or punycode host that differs from an exact declared egress host.
It does not accept a Youdede-named MCP server that is absent from the generated registry.
It does not inspect or restrict MCP servers outside the Youdede namespace.

entrypoints.purpose: Compare every URL and host in a toolkit MCP tool call with the server egress from the generated registry.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block toolkit MCP tool calls that name an undeclared egress host without deferred work.
